admission rejects a core whose format is not ocor.cir/1.0 (RELEASE_REJECTED, path core/format) after the envelope check, so a retained output wrapped in a genuine envelope of a trusted key is still rejected; the publisher inherits it through admission

removing a CAUSAL type emits two changes, destructive and causal-breaking (previously causal-breaking only); a change of a CAUSAL type that removes properties adds a destructive change per removed property; changes are ordered by (path, op, class)

a release whose artifact manifest is missing or partial is ARTIFACT_DRIFT (previously an empty manifest was not compared); preventive review P1

before reading any core field admission checks the CanonicalIRCore shape and runs the conformance suite: a malformed or non-conforming ocor.cir/1.0 core is RELEASE_REJECTED/SOURCE_INVALID, never KeyError/TypeError; the receipt carries the core strings without str() conversion; preventive review P7
new: shape check of the CanonicalIRCore (keys, release strings, SemVer, entry fields per collection) and translation of shape errors into C1Error SOURCE_INVALID; preventive review P7

the IR Protobuf decoder rejects with C1Error SOURCE_INVALID: non-UTF-8 strings, non-finite doubles, integers beyond 2^53, bool other than 0/1, null other than NULL_VALUE, Values with zero or several kinds, unknown ListValue/Struct entry fields, entries without exactly one key and one value, and a core that is not I-JSON; preventive review P5
a YAML mapping key that is not a scalar (unhashable) is SOURCE_INVALID instead of a raw TypeError; preventive review P4

a change of a CAUSAL type is causal-breaking and keeps the conditional and destructive classes of the changes it contains (backfill, backup and replay obligations), instead of reporting causal-breaking only; preventive review P2

modules and the symbol table of the CanonicalIRCore are diffed (export removal, deprecation, namespace change, module removal, symbol moved: breaking; imports: conditional; governance metadata: compatible); malformed cores are rejected with C1Error; preventive review P3 and P7

stored records and the version index are shape-checked and errors translated into C1Error RELEASE_REJECTED; read returns a stored package only if admission accepts it again (forged signature, non-conforming core or incoherent manifest rejected); preventive review P6
a malformed core yields a FAIL report (AttributeError included, structure check guarded) instead of a raw exception; preventive review P7
